mapper.sql: CASE LEAST( CASE WHEN c.product_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN c.product_score ELSE 6 END, CASE WHEN c.packing_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN c.packing_score ELSE 6 END, CASE WHEN c.delivery_comment_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN c.delivery_comment_score ELSE 6 END, CASE WHEN c.food_comment_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN c.food_comment_score ELSE 6 END ) WHEN 1 THEN 'BAD' WHEN 2 THEN 'BAD' WHEN 3 THEN 'NEUTRAL' WHEN 4 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN 5 THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END

c.id, c.shop_id AS shopId, COALESCE(s.poi_name, s.name) AS shopName, c.epoi_id AS epoiId, c.poi_id AS poiId, c.comment_id AS commentId, c.biz_code AS bizCode, c.valid AS valid, c.comment_type AS commentType, c.comment_time AS commentTime, c.comment_content AS commentContent, c.add_comment AS addComment, c.add_comment_time AS addCommentTime, c.order_comment_score AS orderCommentScore, c.food_comment_score AS foodCommentScore, c.delivery_comment_score AS deliveryCommentScore, c.product_score AS productScore, c.packing_score AS packingScore, AS sentiment, c.auto_reply_status AS autoReplyStatus, c.auto_reply_content AS autoReplyContent, c.auto_reply_source AS autoReplySource, COALESCE(rg.llm_model, c.auto_reply_model) AS autoReplyModel, rg.prompt_tokens AS autoReplyPromptTokens, rg.completion_tokens AS autoReplyCompletionTokens, COALESCE(rg.power_amount, c.auto_reply_power_amount) AS autoReplyPowerAmount, COALESCE(rg.duration_ms, c.auto_reply_duration_ms) AS autoReplyDurationMs, c.auto_reply_at AS autoReplyAt, c.auto_reply_error AS autoReplyError, c.analysis_status AS analysisStatus, c.analysis_text AS analysisText, c.analysis_model AS analysisModel, c.analysis_prompt_key AS analysisPromptKey, c.analysis_prompt_version AS analysisPromptVersion, c.analysis_prompt_tokens AS analysisPromptTokens, c.analysis_completion_tokens AS analysisCompletionTokens, c.analysis_power_amount AS analysisPowerAmount, c.analysis_duration_ms AS analysisDurationMs, c.analysis_at AS analysisAt, c.analysis_error AS analysisError, CASE WHEN != 'BAD' THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE' WHEN cp.id IS NULL AND c.complaint_status = 'PENDING' THEN 'NOT_TRIGGERED' ELSE COALESCE(cp.status, c.complaint_status) END AS complaintStatus, COALESCE(cp.report_type_code, c.complaint_report_type_code) AS complaintReportTypeCode, cp.report_type_name AS complaintReportTypeName, COALESCE(cp.report_content, c.complaint_report_content) AS complaintReportContent, cp.power_amount AS complaintPowerAmount, cp.duration_ms AS complaintDurationMs, COALESCE(cp.submitted_at, c.complaint_at) AS complaintAt, COALESCE(cp.error_message, c.complaint_error) AS complaintError, CASE WHEN != 'BAD' THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE' WHEN im.id IS NULL AND c.im_follow_up_status = 'PENDING' THEN 'NOT_TRIGGERED' ELSE COALESCE(im.status, c.im_follow_up_status) END AS imFollowUpStatus, im.failed_stage AS imFailedStage, im.error_code AS imErrorCode, COALESCE(im.error_message, c.im_follow_up_error) AS imErrorMessage, im.message_content AS imMessageContent, im.message_source AS imMessageSource, im.fallback_reason AS imFallbackReason, im.model AS imModel, im.prompt_key AS imPromptKey, im.prompt_version AS imPromptVersion, im.prompt_tokens AS imPromptTokens, im.completion_tokens AS imCompletionTokens, im.total_tokens AS imTotalTokens, im.power_amount AS imPowerAmount, im.generated_at AS imGeneratedAt, im.create_group_attempted_at AS createGroupAttemptedAt, CAST(COALESCE(im.group_id, c.im_group_id) AS CHAR) AS groupId, im.new_group AS newGroup, im.group_ctime AS groupCtime, im.group_state AS groupState, im.group_close_type AS groupCloseType, im.group_created_at AS groupCreatedAt, CAST(im.message_id AS CHAR) AS messageId, im.message_cts AS messageCts, im.send_attempted_at AS sendAttemptedAt, COALESCE(im.sent_at, c.im_message_at) AS sentAt, im.generation_duration_ms AS imGenerationDurationMs, im.create_group_duration_ms AS imCreateGroupDurationMs, im.send_duration_ms AS imSendDurationMs, im.duration_ms AS imDurationMs, c.comment_pictures AS commentPictures

FROM mt_comment c INNER JOIN mt_shop s ON s.id = c.shop_id LEFT JOIN mt_comment_reply_generation rg ON rg.id = c.auto_reply_generation_id LEFT JOIN mt_comment_complaint cp ON cp.mt_comment_id = c.id LEFT JOIN mt_comment_im_follow_up im ON im.mt_comment_id = c.id
